Q5i.question: Can a genuine balanced-RM split-eightfold perfect-complex seed be constructed?
Q5i.finding_ids_or_current_gate: No genuine balanced-RM weakly equivariant semiregular eightfold seed has been constructed. SF-E801--E810 excludes the stated rational-block, integrality and CI-secants; the actual semiregular coneSF-E814 has two-pure character and does not meet this gate. SF-E811--E813 excludes stable/polystable locally free objects and semistable bundles with locally free stable factors. SF-E818 extends this to torsion-free objects with such locally free hulls. SF-E817 excludes all nonzero point defects with a locally free hull, without stability/simplicity. SF-E819/E819R includes nonpure coherent objects: locally free hull with finite kernel/cokernel requires equal lengths at each point, and every nontrivial point must have a nonreduced defect module. The actual rank36 nonpure balanced construction fails this test. SF-E820 excludes all nontrivial modifications with both modules free over a common curvilinear Artinian quotient, of any length; actual rank32 equal-length nonreduced balanced extensions are constructed and excluded. Locally free objects with zero defect require the separate stability exclusions. SF-E815/R excludes the stated simple positive-aggregate projectively-flat models; the seven-class model requiresEndG>=63. SF-E816/a/b/c excludes ordinary-gluable primitive projectively-flat models in any two cohomology degrees, including overlaps/arbitrary gaps, and arbitrary amplitude with globally disjoint classes. SF-E821/E821a excludes every actual local surface summand with a positive squared-eigenpolarization pairing, including the constructed rank16 balanced cones and any torsion-free quotient. SF-E822 excludes equal-rank/equal-degree vector-bundle torsion/defect repairs on smooth integral surfaces of class k²theta², including genuinely coupled rank32 examples and every same-entire-character repair of a balanced hull. SF-E823 excludes every actual global tensor H times the unequal-degree unit surface extension M0, for every positive-rank locally free H and rational B giving the balanced character, without a factorwise finite action. SF-US constructs an actual positive integral full-character example and local nullhomotopies, but no seed. Remaining: unstable bundles, singular stable factors/reflexive hulls, nonreduced equal-length point modifications outside the common-curvilinear-free case, positive-dimensional torsion/defects outsideE818/E821/E822/E823 (including genuinely different global gluing, other unequal-degree, other support classes, nonreduced/singular support or broader derived couplings), overlapping classes in at least3cohomology degrees, twisted or sufficiently nonsimple objects, and broader class spaces. The pure counterexampleE816d does not supply a balanced seed.
